answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 31079 Country: India Title: This is to inquire whether a non-alcoholic drink is lawful, while the bottle, the color of the drink and the taste is similar but rather the same to an Alcoholic drink. But it is 0.0% Alcohol. Question: This is to inquire whether a non-alcoholic drink is lawful, while the bottle, the color of the drink and the taste is similar but rather the same to an Alcoholic drink. But it is 0.0 per cent Alcohol. If it is served in a party just as Alcoholic drinks are served and people drink it as it is an Alcoholic drink, so this kind of act is allowed in Islam. The doer, drinker and the one who serves will be considered as sinner? Answer ID: 31079 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 668/668/M=1432) Drinks free from impure alcohol are lawful. They can be taken as well as offered. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
